commands: ^ LOG\d\[\d+:\d+\]:\ SSL_accept from <HOST>:\d+ : (?P<CODE>[\dA-F]+): error:(?P=CODE):SSL routines:SSL3_GET_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE:peer did not return a certificate$

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any app "" comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against stunnel"
else
ufw prepend reject from <ip> to any comment "by Fail2Ban after <failures> attempts against stunnel"
fi

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any app ""
else
ufw delete reject from <ip> to any
fi

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -D $chain -p $proto -j f2b-nagios
done; done
<iptables> -F f2b-nagios
<iptables> -X f2b-nagios

for chain in $(echo 'INPUT' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
<iptables> -C $chain -p $proto -j f2b-nagios
done; done

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
mta = mail
banaction_allports = nftables[type=allports]
banaction = iptables-allports
[stunnel]
enabled = true
maxretry = 0
bantime = 10m
findtime = 3600
action = ufw
[nagios]
enabled = true
backend = pyinotify
logpath = /nonexistent/%(__name__)s.log
maxretry = 1_0
bantime = 1h 30m

stderr:
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'stunnel' jail.
fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'nagios' jail.
